claim: § The Physics: 'A wall 10 meters away returns its reflection 29 milliseconds late. Your brain reads those arrival times as geometry' — and Loudon's comment asks how room dimensions and room size work together.

pieces.what: One clap and one wall: drag the wall, t = d/343 updates, hear the echo fuse into room as it nears; then add walls and a Sabine RT60 readout from the room's dimensions — answers the comment's question
pieces.walks_up_from: a single reflection from one wall

pieces.what: Haas slider: delay one channel 0–40 ms on headphones; width appears with no spatial change, then splits into an echo
pieces.walks_up_from: the same click in both ears

pieces.what: One vocal dry / small room / hall / cathedral, asking 'where are you?'
